title: Poland will shoot down objects violating its airspace, PM says, as UN security council to meet over Russian provocations – Europe live
summary: Donald Tusk says Poland will not hesitate to shoot objects down but cautions against action that could trigger conflict The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity, or ENISA, just said that the cyberattack that disrupted several European airports ( 11:45 ) has now been confirmed to be a ransomware attack. Meanwhile, Poland’s prime minister Donald Tusk warned that Poland would not hesitate and shoot down any objects that “violate our territory and fly over Poland.” Continue reading...
